meta.name: O Sthree Repu Raa
meta.description: Monica is a writer who desperately tries to publish her stories. In this process, a publisher commissions her to write about the "O Sthree Repu Raa" story which got several villages shivering in the past. Monica and her boyfriend try out various means to know the mysteries behind this story. Finally, Monica finds her story after she plays a planchet game with the souls of the dead.
